typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Archive_location as string (),
	Archive_path as string (),
	CountyResultSet as string (),
	COUNTY_CODE as string (),
	COUNTY_CRITERIA as string (),
	COUNTY_NAME as string (),
	EMAIL_RECIPIENTS as string (),
	FILENAME as string (),
	FILENAME_TEMPLATE as string (),
	Month_name as string (),
	Outbound_location as string (),
	Record_count as integer (),
	Report_Run_Date as timestamp (),
	STATUS_FLAG as integer (),
	Template_path as string ()
}

source(output(
		COUNTY_NAME as string,
		EMAIL_RECIPIENTS as string,
		COUNTY_CRITERIA as string,
		STATUS_FLAG as integer,
		FILENAME_TEMPLATE as string,
		COUNTY_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select COUNTY_CODE, COUNTY_NAME, ISNULL(EMAIL_RECIPIENTS, \' \') AS EMAIL_RECIPIENTS, 		ISNULL(COUNTY_CRITERIA, \' \') AS COUNTY_CRITERIA, ISNULL(FILENAME_TEMPLATE, \' \') AS FILENAME_TEMPLATE, 		ISNULL(STATUS_FLAG, 0) AS STATUS_FLAG  from	##CA_REBID_POP_HLTH_EMAIL_CC WHERE COUNTY_NAME IS NOT NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		COUNTY_NAME as string,
		EMAIL_RECIPIENTS as string,
		COUNTY_CRITERIA as string,
		STATUS_FLAG as integer,
		FILENAME_TEMPLATE as string,
		COUNTY_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		COUNTY_NAME,
		EMAIL_RECIPIENTS,
		COUNTY_CRITERIA,
		STATUS_FLAG,
		FILENAME_TEMPLATE,
		COUNTY_CODE)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderRecordsetDestination
